parts.problem_md:
Sean records the maximum and minimum temperatures, in °C, at a museum. 
Some of the results for one week are shown in the table.

| Day | Mon | Tue | Wed | Thu | Fri | Sat | Sun |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Maximum temperature (°C) | 8 | 12 | 15 | 14 | 11 | 7 | 4 |
| Minimum temperature (°C) | -5 | -2 | -4 | -1 | 3 |   |   |

i) Find the difference between the maximum temperature and the minimum temperature on Wednesday.

............................................. °C [1]

ii) The minimum temperature on Saturday was 2°C higher than the minimum temperature on Monday.

Find the minimum temperature on Saturday.

............................................. °C [1]

iii) In this week the range of temperatures was 23°C.

Find the minimum temperature on Sunday.

............................................. °C [1]
parts.solution_md:
(i) *Subtract Wednesday's minimum temperature from Wednesday's maximum temperature. *

`15 minus open parentheses negative 4 close parentheses equals 19`

$19^{\circ}C$* ***[1]**

(ii) *The minimum temperature on Monday was *$-5^{\circ}C$*.*

> *Add *$2^{\circ}C$*. *

$-5+2=-3$

$-3^{\circ}C$ **[1]**

(iii) *The range (*$23^{\circ}C$*) is the difference between the highest temperature (*$15^{\circ}C$*) and the lowest temperature.* * *

$15-23=-8$

$-8^{\circ}C$* ***[1]**

equations.alt: bold minus bold 3 bold degree bold C
bold minus bold 8 bold degree bold C

parts.problem_md:
Alexa, Ben and Chloe own a restaurant.

Alexa records some temperatures.

Fridge 4 °C    Cool box -3°C    Freezer -19°C

i) Find the difference in temperature between the fridge and the cool box.

............................................ °C [1]

ii) Find the difference in temperature between the cool box and the freezer.

............................................ °C [1]

iii) The temperature in the cold room is 5°C lower than the fridge.

Find the temperature in the cold room.

............................................ °C [1]
parts.solution_md:
(i) *Subtract the lower temperature (the cool box temperature of *$-3^{\circ}C$*) from the higher temperature (the fridge temperature of *$4^{\circ}C$*). *

> `4 minus open parentheses negative 3 close parentheses equals 7`* *

$7^{\circ}C$* ***[1]**

(ii) *Subtract the lower temperature (the freezer temperature of *$-19^{\circ}C$*) from the higher temperature (the cool box temperature of *$-3^{\circ}C$*). *

> `negative 3 minus open parentheses negative 19 close parentheses equals 16`*  *

$16^{\circ}C$* ***[1]**

(iii) *Subtract the *$5^{\circ}C$* from the fridge temperature (*$4^{\circ}C$*). *

> $4-5=-1$* *

$-1^{\circ}C$* ***[1]**
